exp: Third person singular present tense: goes. Answer: goes
'Yesterday' requires past tense: bought. Answer: bought
Present continuous with 'he': is playing. Answer: is

q: They ____ not finished their work yet.
exp: 'They' takes 'have'; present perfect with 'yet'. Answer: have
Universal truth takes simple present: rises. Answer: rises
'Since' with a point in time; 'for' with duration. Answer: since
'Allergic to' is the correct collocation. Answer: to

q: The train had left ____ I reached the station.
exp: Past perfect 'had left' pairs with 'before'. Answer: before
'Good at' is the correct collocation. Answer: at
'Died in' an accident; 'died of' a disease. Answer: in

q: Neither of the two answers ____ correct.
exp: 'Neither' is singular: is correct. Answer: is

q: The committee ____ divided in their opinion.
exp: Collective noun showing individual members acting: 'are'. Answer: are

q: Hardly had he arrived ____ it started raining.
exp: 'Hardly...when' is the correct correlative pair. Answer: when
'Insist on' is the correct collocation. Answer: on

q: No sooner had he spoken ____ the audience applauded.
exp: 'No sooner...than' is the correct correlative pair. Answer: than
